title: Skills runtime tools: skills_catalog + skill_load MetaprojectOperations (R1+R2 from keryx-skills-runtime-tools docpack)

AC1.note: PR #359 merged (4b78e77): MetaprojectOperation['module'] widened to include 'gdskills' at metaproject-operations.ts:50; every pre-existing operation's module tag unchanged, verified via full diff.

AC2.note: skillsCatalog walks .metaproject/skills/gdskills/**/SKILL.md (name/path/category/description/triggers); tests confirm real discovery, catalog.md description-fallback (added in T4 review round), and schema conformance against skills-catalog-result.schema.json.

AC3.note: loadSkill byte-identical content test + not-found (found:false, empty content/path, never throws) both covered in metaproject-adapter.test.ts, verified against skill-load-result.schema.json.

AC4.note: Both operations risk:read; toInteractiveTools/toToolDefinitions/toMcpTools reachability all covered by dedicated tests mirroring wiki_backlinks/flow_status precedent; no bespoke src/mcp/metaproject-tools.ts wiring needed (confirmed by review).

AC5.note: skillsCatalog/loadSkill are pure fs reads confined under .metaproject/skills/gdskills (confineToSkills, catalog-gated lookup) -- no network/shell/write anywhere in the new code, confirmed by review focus area 2.

AC6.note: No behavior change to the 13 pre-existing operations, shell.ts, .claude/skills/, or gdskills install/sync/catalog.ts -- full diff reviewed, additive only.

AC7.note: 389 pass/0 fail locally across the 4 directly-affected test files pre-merge; CI typecheck-and-tests green after 2 fix rounds (2 more pre-existing hardcoded tool-list tests CI caught beyond T3's local scope) plus 1 unrelated-flake re-run (serve.process.test.ts SIGINT timing).

AC8.note: bun run typecheck clean throughout (ground truth); keryx health run WARN was the installed global keryx binary's own stale-build limitation (typescript source unavailable), independently corroborated by T4's reviewer; CI's real typecheck-and-tests job (which runs the actual tsc+bun test) passed green on PR #359 after fixes.
